properties.description: Real-path test: drives the core open (DesignGraph::open_rocksdb) and the shipped binary's --call door. Ten cases: symlinked first open then the real path; `--graph-path .`; a plain path leaves exactly graph.id.json and graph.meta.json beside the store with the same four-field record and says nothing; two stores WRITTEN BY THE RELEASED 0.76.0 BINARY (tests/fixtures/legacy-identity/, through a symlink and as `.`) open by their old spelling and by their real path, in both orders, the copy byte-identical to the old file and the old file untouched; a refused open leaves `.reflow2/` byte-identical (bytes and mtimes); the refusal names every place looked, the id the store's keys carry and the recovery, and that id file opens the design; the field case (0.76.0 symlink store opened by its real path first); two identity files naming different designs.
properties.name: a_stores_identity_follows_its_real_path.rs — a store's identity follows its real path, stores an older reflow2 made still open, and a refused open writes nothing
